question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Inchoate
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'** i.e.** 'Refined'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Inchoate" **means just begun and so not fully formed or developed; rudimentary.(अपूर्ण)
 
• The opposite in meaning to** "Inchoate"** would be: **Refined.**
 
• **It means** developed or improved so as to be precise or subtle.(संशोधित)

Therefore, the **correct answer **is:** 'Refined'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Here are the explanations for the rest of the words:
 
 
• **Artless -** it means without guile or deception or lacking art, knowledge, or skill.(सीधा-सादा)
 
• **Articulate -** it means having or showing the ability to speak fluently and coherently.(स्पष्ट)
 
• **Formless - **it means without a clear or definite shape or structure. (अरूप)
